scope: Independent source/behavior verification of geography board gestures at b215d722. Six-region catalog and full task16 acceptance are out of scope.

skillPerspectiveCheck.programming: Loaded TypeScript README and type-patterns. Diff violates the empty-catch iron rule and duplicates identical tagged-design branches. The pointerup listener is not a stable trampoline, so removeEventListener cannot release the registered callback.
skillPerspectiveCheck.removeAiSlops: Loaded skill categories. Production slop: empty catch, copy-pasted if/else with identical bodies, document listener that is not RAII-stable. Producer tests forge occurrence coordinates as a baseline and pin GEOGRAPHY_TILE_PX arithmetic. Complementary probes assert observable occurrence/library/error outcomes from recipe fixtures, not implementation constants.

summary: Isolated pointer/keyboard gestures do write recipe occurrence coordinates in placed mode and only source design slots in source mode. Out-of-bounds on a fresh board is typed clipped with zero live/draft mutation. Empty-terrain entry keeps the named lake-country port. Scrolled 8px mapping hits working-mine at x=100. Keyboard nudge plus compiled preview/apply/undo/redo retains sibling x=46 and mapConnection ids. Blocking: after a gesture that rerenders before pointerup, a later instance out-of-bounds drop reports unknown-child because document.pointerup listeners are registered as the current finishMove value and never removed.
blocking: spatialGeographyCanvas.ts registers document.addEventListener('pointerup', pendingDrop.run) then reassigns pendingDrop.run on every render. removeEventListener(pendingDrop.run) cannot drop the previously registered finishMove. After a mid-gesture rerender, a later placed out-of-bounds drop yields unknown-child instead of clipped.

findings.detail: childButton pointerdown adds pendingDrop.run; renderSpatialGeographyCanvas replaces pendingDrop.run with a new finishMove; finishMove/Escape remove the new function, not the registered one. Isolated instance OOB is clipped; the same drop after a rerendered region drag is unknown-child.
